تنتدبن (form VIII)
# تَنْتَدِبْنَ (tantadibna) /tan.ta.dib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# تُنْتَدَبْنَ (tuntadabna) /tun.ta.dab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
